plainTranslation: With Composite Mercury in the 1st house, your ability to express yourselves and communicate openly with one another can be strong. You can feel better able to communicate with one another than with other people, and conversation can be a strong tie that helps you get along. In a romantic relationship, you have to make sure you're making an attempt to keep passion strong, otherwise the relationship can lose sparks quickly. This can be a great position for virtually any other type of relationship though.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
